title: Radio: Rover 3 Reports Empty Polling Location 6

lines.text: Deputy, this is Rover 3. We’ve just arrived at Polling Location 6 (Carrow Community Church). No one is there. The door is unlocked, and the paper pollbook is still on the table. We’re not seeing any signs of a move. The spoofed email might be fake. But the front desk is empty. We’re securing the room now.

We’ve locked the door from the inside. No signs of forced entry. All equipment is present, including the DS850 tabulator and Pollbook 64. The VoterTrack tablet is powered off and unplugged. No one else is on site.
Requesting confirmation: should we initiate a full site verification with the Sheriff’s liaison, or proceed with a manual check of the logbooks and ballot storage?

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should triage it down without engaging. The rover confirms the site is unoccupied and secured, which validates the spoofed email's falsity.
